name: Treasure Seekers 3: Follow the Ghosts
storyline: After a successful return from Romania, Tom is still drawn to adventures. Upon stumbling across a newspaper article about ghost sightings in a manor in England, he decides to head there. This time, Nelly is reluctant to let her brother go alone and joins him. However, during their investigation of the mysterious stories about ghosts, undead, and yetis, the siblings find themselves having to split up, only to reunite on the vast expanses of Siberia…
summary:
The captivating quest "Treasure Seekers 3: Follow the Ghosts" from the creators of the beloved games "Treasure Seekers" and "Treasure Seekers 2" continues the tale of Tom and Nelly's adventures. They have grown up, and now childish pranks no longer interest them. The pursuit of ghosts, communication with the undead, and solving complex puzzles - this is the real adventure for our heroes.

The excellent graphics and musical score of "Treasure Seekers 3: Follow the Ghosts" are sure to please all fans of interesting games and thrilling adventures. An engaging storyline, puzzles, and mini-games that are not easy to solve - all of this awaits you in this exciting game.
